# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

Greptile Summary

 The PR hardens Redis2 orphaned directory-index cleanup while preserving entries that may still represent live data. - Derives Redis keys internally from the directory path and filename. - Skips destructive cleanup for configured super-large directories. - Makes removal-and-restoration compensation survive request cancellation and logs restoration failures. - Preserves value-less directories whose child indexes still contain entries. - Expands Redis-backed tests across key prefixes and edge cases.

Confidence Score: 5/5

 The PR appears safe to merge. No blocking failure remains.

Important Files Changed

 | Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | weed/filer/redis2/universal_redis_store.go | Strengthens orphan-index cleanup with consistent key derivation, super-large-directory protection, cancellation-independent compensation, child-index checks, and restore-error logging. | | weed/filer/redis2/universal_redis_store_test.go | Adds coverage for prefixed keys, recreated entries, value-less directories with children, super-large directories, and reliable test cleanup. |
